project_name: MedGL - General Medicine PPL & Revision Platform

image_urls.description: Medical book and stethoscope for revision platform

key_functionalities: Tableau de bord étudiant (Student dashboard with progress & modules)
Modules médicaux (Cardiologie, Pneumologie, Neurologie, Gastro-entérologie, etc.)
Quiz interactifs avec scores et corrections
Tableau de bord administrateur (Protégé par code/login admin)
CRUD complet pour les modules, chapitres, textes, fiches, quiz, questions & réponses
Gestion des utilisateurs et statistiques de la plateforme
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full stack medical revision platform inspired by AeroGligli (for PPL) adapted for medical general practice (Medecine Generale). Include a fully functional student area with modules, lessons, revision sheets, interactive quizzes, and progress tracker. Include a protected Admin Panel (with login email & password / passcode) that allows full CRUD operations on modules, chapters, contents, quiz questions, answers, user management, stats, and display order customization.
universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
Use generous spacing, clear typography hierarchy, and professional medical color palette.
